title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 101 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 101 - Deduction of Tax from surveyor's fees etc of the General Insurance Company A person responsible for paying a resident by way of remuneration or fee for conducting a survey for the purpose of settling an insurance claim of an insurer shall, at the time of payment, deduct income-tax at the rate of 15% (fifteen percent) on the gross amount.
